title.en: Notes from the .tex on the PDF
title.zh: 在 PDF 上显示 .tex 中的批注

body.en: Annotations made in a .tex file now also show on the PDF, on the words they belong to, with the same marks, pins and cards as notes made on the PDF.
body.zh: 在 .tex 文件中添加的批注现在也会显示在 PDF 上，落在对应的文字处，标记、图钉和卡片都与在 PDF 上添加的批注一致。

fixes.en: Marks on the PDF follow their words after a rebuild that changes only some pages.
fixes.zh: 重新编译只改动了部分页面时，PDF 上的标记仍会跟随对应的文字。

fixes.en: Choosing Select All from the menu and then typing now always replaces everything.
fixes.zh: 从菜单选择“全选”后再输入，现在总能替换全部内容。

fixes.en: The in-browser demo opens PNG figures as images, loads images in Markdown notes, shows a placeholder while it starts, and explains that Source control runs in the Mac app instead of showing an error.
fixes.zh: 浏览器在线演示现在会把 PNG 图片显示为图像、能加载 Markdown 笔记中的图片、启动时显示占位画面，并说明 Git 功能需在 Mac 应用中使用，而不再报错。

fixes.en: The README links the browser demo and the release notes, and the project now has a code of conduct.
fixes.zh: README 新增了浏览器在线演示和更新说明的链接，项目也有了行为准则。
